name: Toast
summary: Passive notification item with independent visual and announcement priority, optional safe Button action and canonical dismissal, semantic hidden state, and target-owned viewport, queue, timing, and lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Notification item surface that owns border, shadow, content layout, and item motion but not global viewport placement.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Content and announcement region for title and message, excluding interactive actions from the live string.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Optional canonical Button action that is safe to ignore.

anatomy.name: close
anatomy.description: Optional named dismiss action composed with canonical Close Button.

states.name: hidden
states.description: Resting hidden state unavailable to pointer and assistive technology.

behavior.name: visibility
behavior.description: The item is visibility- and accessibility-hidden by default and becomes available when is-visible and aria-hidden=false are applied.

behavior.name: announcement
behavior.description: The content region uses polite status or assertive alert semantics only when dynamically inserted; actions remain outside the announced string.

behavior.name: dismissal
behavior.description: Explicit dismissal belongs to the item; timeout, Escape, pause/resume, queue, and removal belong to the target viewport service.

behavior.name: safeAction
behavior.description: An optional canonical Button action is safe to ignore and has a persistent alternative when the target may time out the toast.

behavior.name: passiveFocus
behavior.description: Presenting a toast never moves keyboard focus from the user's current task.

properties.name: message
properties.description: Visible notification message that communicates meaning without icon or color alone.

properties.name: action
properties.description: Optional named canonical Button action that remains safe to ignore.

properties.name: dismissAction
properties.description: Optional named button that requests dismissal.

properties.name: dismissLabel
properties.description: Accessible name for the optional dismiss action.

properties.name: announcement
properties.description: Live-region priority used when the toast is inserted dynamically.

properties.name: visible
properties.description: Controls visible toast presentation; target timing and queue management remain external.

accessibility: Put status/alert semantics on the content region so interactive actions are excluded from the announced string.
Use polite status for routine notifications and assertive alert only for genuinely urgent changes; visual Error does not imply assertive.
Provide a clear named canonical dismiss action when the toast persists or contains an action.
Never move keyboard focus when presenting a passive toast.
Keep optional actions safe to ignore and provide a persistent alternative when a target may time out the item.
Target viewport services pause automatic dismissal on hover, focus, and window blur and avoid concurrent assertive announcements.
Keep hidden items unavailable to pointer and assistive technology.
Honor reduced motion and preserve text, boundaries, and focus in forced-colors mode.

web.notes: Canonical CSS implements one notification item and semantic hidden state. Target services own insertion, live timing, viewport placement, queueing, pause/resume, duration, and removal.
